CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_diamond_guarantee_copy(p_text text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT replace(p_text, 'Chip Guarantee', 'Diamond Guarantee') $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_place_guarantee(p_guarantee numeric, p_bounty_pool numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT greatest(0, round(coalesce(p_guarantee,0),2)
                     - greatest(0, round(coalesce(p_bounty_pool,0),2)));
$function$
